Weng.Access
Class AccessQuery

java.lang.Object
  |
  +--Weng.Access.AccessQuery
public class AccessQuery
extends java.lang.Object

An object of the class AccessQuery serves as a proxy to a Microsoft Access database queries. Special low-level implementation issues require this class to be implemented as a factory. That is, the static method Create() is used to construct an AccessQuery object, and the static method Destroy() is used to remove an AccessQuery object.
